To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the work-related regulatory focus scale has a two-dimensional structure, and the prevention and promotion dimensions of work-related regulatory focus are positively associated with the chronic regulatory focus dimensions of the same names.

the Work Regulatory Focus (WRF) Scale has two factors, prevention and promotion, and that these two factors correlate with each other and with the corresponding factors of the Chronic Regulatory focus (CRF) Questionnaire.

(1) work-related prevention and work-related promotion are separate but correlated constructs; (2) the Work Regulatory Focus scale is a valid and reliable measure of these constructs; and (3) the two work regulatory focus dimensions have a small but significant association with the chronic regulatory focus dimensions of prevention and promotion.
